claims: Fixing any other raw input j to either0 or1 leaves each distinct input i essential.
A binary raw-raw AND or OR with distinct operands requires another reader of either operand.
A least target9 circuit cannot contain a repeated-raw-input AND/OR gate, since it is an alias.
No least target9 circuit with at most14 gates can contain an AND gate with two raw operands, at any position.
In particular, the first gate cannot be AND.
